excerpt: Taken together, Fading Bright and Litchfield reveal the emotional and conceptual breadth possible within contemporary ambient music when approached with sincerity and imagination. Both artists resist easy categorization or formulaic structures, choosing instead to create deeply immersive worlds shaped by texture, emotion, and atmosphere. Transforming space, perception, and mood Perceptual Tapes continues to establish itself as one of the more quietly essential labels operating within…
_cn_summary: Fading Bright（上海）与Litchfield（美国）两位在氛围/实验电子领域深耕多年的独立音乐人，在《2View》中各自主导约15分钟的作品——前者采用模块合成器与细腻的旋律微循环营造层叠声床，后者以稀疏的噪音纹理、极简低频脉冲配合现场录音和精准的空间混响打造沉浸式音景。专辑的核心听感在于两种截然不同的纹理在“情感驱动、空间感知”的统一理念下相互映衬，使听者在微妙的情绪起伏中感受到细腻的张力与深度。该作再次印证了独立厂牌 Perceptual Tapes 在当代氛围音乐中低调而不可或缺的影响力。

excerpt: The resulting experience of Sorry I Didn't Realize feels untethered from trends or nostalgia bait, instead standing defiantly above contemporaries as both tribute and evolution — easily deserving placement near summit of any Best of 2026 conversation. Blueprints for worlds hidden somewhere between memory and machinery Sorry I Didn't Realize by iNFO At thirteen in 1990, somewhere amid the neon haze of early ’90s arcades and stacks of dubbed cassette tapes, my older brother cracked open a portal…
_cn_summary: iNFO在90年代初的霓虹街机灯光和卡带翻录氛围中成长，13岁时受兄长启发踏入电子音乐创作，形成了以记忆与机械交织为核心的美学。《Sorry I Didn't Realize》以复古合成器、芯片音效与当代电子制作相结合，呈现出既致敬90年代又超前实验的声景，构建出蓝图纸般的世界蓝图。专辑通过层层递进的噪声纹理、细腻的模拟合成与流畅的旋律线，营造出冷峻又富情感冲击的沉浸式听感，被誉为2026年最佳专辑的强劲竞争者。

tags: world music, traditional music, world fusion
excerpt: Sixteen years after its inception, Seu Jorge presents The Other Side as an invitation into some of the most captivating styles of Brazilian music, MPB, jazz, samba and bossa nova. It is also a deeply personal statement from Seu Jorge. Jorge treats Brazilian musical tradition with reverence, passion and restless curiosity. Masterfully produced by Mario Caldato Jr. and beautifully orchestrated by composer and multi-instrumentalist Miguel Atwood-Ferguson, the record offers elegant orchestral splend
_cn_summary: Seu Jorge，巴西资深歌手兼词曲作者，以 MPB、桑巴、波萨诺瓦与爵士的跨界融合著称，十六年来的新专辑《The Other Side》再次展现其对巴西音乐传统的敬意与不安分的探索。该专辑由 Mario Caldato Jr. 制作，Miguel Atwood‑Ferguson 进行交响编曲，以细腻的弦乐、钢琴与柔和的打击乐构建出兼具古典华丽与拉丁律动的听感。Jorge 醇厚的嗓音与极具叙事性的歌词交织，使《The Other Side》在情感深度与音乐层次上都堪称今年巴西乐坛的亮点。

tags: world music, traditional music, world fusion
excerpt: Mimika Orchestra has released Medzotermina, its fifth studio album. The 20-piece ensemble, conducted by composer Mak Murtić, recorded most of the nine-track album at Vatroslav Lisinski Concert Hall. Founded in London in 2010 and later based in Zagreb, Croatia, Mimika Orchestra amalgamates world music traditions with contemporary jazz. Medzotermina convinces with its mix of elegant folk-rooted vocals, powerful ensemble horns and virtuosic solos. The group previewed the album with “Dišpet,” “Klapa
_cn_summary: Mimika Orchestra是一支于2010年在伦敦创立、后迁至克罗地亚萨格勒布的20人编制大乐团，由作曲家Mak Murtić执棒，已发行第五张录音室专辑《Medzotermina》，其中九首曲目大部分在Vatroslav Lisinski音乐厅录制。专辑将世界音乐传统与当代爵士融合，以优雅的民谣声线、强劲的合奏铜管和技巧精湛的独奏为亮点，前卫曲目《Dišpet》《Klapa》尤显乐团层次感与即兴张力。整体听感兼具仪式感与现场感，展示了乐团在跨界融合上的成熟把控。

excerpt: Urlo, the bassist, keyboardist, and lead vocalist from the Italian psychedelic metal band Ufomammut, has a solo project titled The Mon. The most recent release, from March of this year, is titled Songs of Embrace . Itâs meant to be a companion album to last autumnâs Songs of Abandon . The albumâs structures are very different, however. While Songs of Abandon featured acoustic tunes with vocals, Songs of Embrace is entirely instrumental and highly electronic. âWhile the first part explore
_cn_summary: 《Songs of Embrace》是意大利迷幻金属乐队 Ufomammut 的低音吉他手/键盘手/主唱 Urlo 的个人项目 The Mon 的最新专辑，于今年三月发行，定位为去年秋季《Songs of Abandon》的配套作品。整张专辑全程纯器乐，摒弃人声，采用厚重的电子合成器、低频脉冲和氛围层叠，营造出暗黑工业与太空氛围交织的聆听空间。最值得关注的是，Urlo 将 Ufomammut 的重型迷幻金属基底与极简电子声场相结合，使强劲的低频冲击与寂静的合成音景形成强烈对比，兼具实验性与冲击力，适合喜欢重型与电子实验的听众。

excerpt: Longer Than Spring by For Breakfast After four years, North London’s For Breakfast return with Longer Than Spring , an LP trading the murky, sprawling friction of the seven-piece band’s roots for a leaner, solo-led architecture. It’s a sophisticated if occasionally sanitised evolution; while the band’s signature virtuosity remains, it is now tethered to the singular narrative of vocalist and keys player Maya Harrison. This shift is catalysed by Harrison’s decade-long recovery from illness, frami
_cn_summary: 伦敦北部的七人乐团 For Breakfast 在四年沉寂后推出专辑《Longer Than Spring》，舍弃过去混沌庞大的七人编制，转而围绕主唱兼键盘手 Maya Harrison 打造以 solo 为核心的简洁结构。专辑保留了乐团标志性的精湛演奏，却又将叙事重心落在 Harrison 因十年疾病康复而形成个人故事线，使整体氛围更为内敛且具自传色彩。听觉上融合了细腻钢琴线条与轻快流行元素，虽偶显刻意的精致感，却呈现出一次值得关注的技术与情感平衡的进化。

album: It's Nice To See A Lake In Your Eyes
excerpt: It's fairly common practice these days for artists to collaborate with each other over long distances. Musical stems are shared instantly, the old-fashioned studio room no longer a necessity in the digital age when musicians can guest on each other's records without ever meeting. Carol Maia and Jeremy Gustin have created an album with thousands of miles between Carol's home in Rio de Janeiro and Jeremy's in Brooklyn but have done so with a rare alchemy.
_cn_summary: Carol Maia是巴西里约的歌手兼作曲家，Jeremy Gustin则是来自纽约布鲁克林的打击乐手与制作人，两人通过远程文件传输完成了跨越数千英里的合作《It's Nice To See A Lake In Your Eyes》。专辑以轻盈的吉他、细腻的键盘与层次丰富的打击乐交织，融合巴西节奏的柔和律动与纽约独立音乐的冷峻氛围，营造出温暖且略带梦幻的听感。值得注意的是，虽然两人相隔两地，作品中仍保留了高度的即兴张力与人声/鼓点的互动，使整张专辑在亲密感与实验性之间取得难得的平衡。

excerpt: Álvaro Torres laid the groundwork for his jazz journey in a common way (for this uncommon profession): by studying classical piano from a young age. The aspect of improvisation pulled him away from the classical world, into a globe-trotting search based in Spanish folkloric and Hindustani music and jazz and a Master's degree at the Manhattan School of Music. He blends these diverse forms of musical expression on Mairena.
_cn_summary: Álvaro Torres 是一位从古典钢琴转向即兴演奏的爵士钢琴手，曾在西班牙民谣与印度斯坦音乐环境中深造，并在曼哈顿音乐学院获得硕士学位。Mairena 这张专辑将西班牙弗拉明戈式的旋律、印度拉格的音阶与当代爵士和声巧妙融合，营造出兼具地域色彩与即兴张力的跨文化声音。最值得关注的是 Torres 与三重奏在吉他、打击乐与钢琴之间的对话——西班牙吉他与人声点缀的节奏层与印度鼓点的呼应，形成层次丰富且充满惊喜的听感体验。

excerpt: This is one heck of an album, with something for everyone, from free jazz lovers to punk vocal style and hints of classical in the string lines. It is mesmeric and different, yet there is also a familiarity – the sense of musicians coming together and creating free jazz that does just what this kind of music does – connects and communicates.
_cn_summary: DoYeon Kim 是一位出生于韩国、兼具古典钢琴功底并在纽约实验爵士圈活跃的钢琴家/作曲家，其作品常在即兴与结构之间寻找张力。《Wellspring》以自由爵士的即兴为根基，融合朋克式嘶哑声线与古典弦乐四重奏的对位式编排，在粗犷的原始冲击与精致的音乐对话中自由切换。从高能鼓点驱动的开场段落到弦乐四重奏的高潮爆发，专辑呈现出催眠般的凝聚力与现场即兴的即时感，既让自由爵士爱好者感受到熟悉的交流氛围，也给朋克与古典乐迷提供跨界的新鲜体验。

excerpt: A beautiful conclusion for a great album. The album draws spiritual inspiration from John and Alice Coltrane while maintaining Beger's unique vision—a life-affirming statement transforming grief into something transcendent.
_cn_summary: Albert Beger 是以色列萨克斯演奏家，作品常融合自由即兴与精神爵士，刻意借鉴 John Coltrane 后期的冥想式结构与 Alice Coltrane 的宇宙灵性；《Astral Visit》以萨克斯、钢琴、贝斯、鼓四人编制呈现，采用慢速模态旋律并在其中穿插即兴对话，音色温暖且带有中东与东方音阶的余韵；专辑最亮眼的听感在于将个人悲伤升华为肯定生命的抒情宣言，深沉情感层次与高潮段落超凡的升华感相互交织，值得在当代精神爵士乐迷中重点关注。

excerpt: For nearly a decade, SUSS has been on a fascinating journey through the center of the sound known as ambient country: a journey defined by low speeds, high productivity, remarkable consistency, and the ability to make subtle changes that move their music forward without leaving behind their essential charm. Listening to their discography is like looking out the window on a long drive across the prairie states. Counting Sunsets offers further evidence that, as gifted as SUSS is at exploration, they're just as good at getting back home—and they're helping define a genre along the way.
_cn_summary:
SUSS 是一支自约十年前起步的美国独立乐队，专长于将氛围音乐的空灵层次与乡村乐器的温暖质感相融合，形成所谓的“氛围乡村”风格。  
《Counting Sunsets》以低速节拍、悠扬的踏板钢弦、细腻的合成纹理以及辽阔的自然采样，营造出如同在平原公路上行驶时窗外的暮光余晖般的沉浸感，同时在编曲上加入了更明显的律动层次，使作品在保持宁静氛围的同时更具推进力。  
这张专辑再次证明 SUSS 在不牺牲自身柔和魅力的前提下，能够以细微的音乐结构变化推动风格演进，正逐步成为氛围乡村领域的标杆之作。

excerpt: Lost Hope Society doesn’t deal in easy optimism. Instead, it locates hope as a kind of underlying signal—constant, even when masked by noise. Like Midsommar , it uses brightness to reveal shadow, and in doing so, turns discomfort into clarity. Sometimes playful, sometimes disquieting Lost Hope Society by The Music Liberation Front Sweden   Listening to The Music Liberation Front Sweden on Lost Hope Society feels like stepping into Ari Aster ’s Midsommar refracted through analog…
_cn_summary: Lost Hope Society 是瑞典实验音乐组织 The Music Liberation Front Sweden 的专辑，乐队擅长以温暖的模拟合成器和低频噪声交织出浓郁的氛围音景。专辑以明亮的高频旋律照亮暗流涌动的阴影，呈现出与 Ari Aster 电影《Midsommar》相似的诡异光明感，既玩味又不安；在此之上，微弱的“希望”被设计为掩埋在层层噪声中的底层信号，贯穿全篇。其细腻的模拟音色、层次分明的声场布局以及光明与黑暗的对位，使得这张专辑在当代氛围音乐中独树一帜，值得在高质量音响环境中细听。

excerpt: Two of my favorite sonic sculptors converge as F~M , alias of Roel Funcken and Jeroen Bax (aka exm ), shaping Fose into four extended chapters that warp and reassemble rhythmic glitch fragments, threaded with fluid collisions of bass pressure, flickering bleeps, and meticulous sound design . Stretched temporal haze Two of my favorite sonic sculptors converge as F~M , alias of Roel Funcken and Jeroen Bax (aka exm ), shaping Fose into four extended chapters that warp and reassemble rhythmic…
_cn_summary: 荷兰实验电子老将 Roel Funcken 与 Jeroen Bax（以 exm 为名）以新 alias F~M 再度合作，将《Fose》塑造成四段长篇的 glitch‑节奏与 bass‑冲击交织的声场；在精密的声波雕刻、流体低音压力与闪烁的电子 bleep 中呈现出时间拉伸的雾气氛围。专辑的听感亮点在于层次分明的动态转折与细腻的音色细节，既具冲击感又保持高度抽象的空间感，值得在实验俱乐部或深度聆听时关注。

excerpt: Accelerate doesn’t chase nostalgia or novelty in isolation—it integrates both. Poladroïd works within electro’s lineage while actively reconfiguring its edges, balancing discipline with invention. The result is a concise but fully realized statement: technically sharp, atmospherically rich, and rhythmically compelling throughout. Forward motion and retrograde pull aren’t in conflict; they’re fused Poladroïd ’s grasp of electro is something I rate highly from the outset. Coming up through the…
_cn_summary: Poladroïd是一位在华语地下电子场景成长、擅长将复古合成器音色与现代编曲语言融合的制作人。Accelerate EP在强劲节拍驱动力和锋利的合成纹理中营造浓厚氛围，兼顾复古回溯与前瞻性冲击，表现出技术精细与声音层次兼具的风格。整张作品以紧凑结构、细腻的声音设计以及行进感与怀旧感之间的无缝切换，值得在舞池与耳机中反复聆听。

excerpt: Mastered and recorded at Elektronmusikstudion (EMS) in Stockholm between 2024 and 2026, I Det Vassa Ljuset is based on close-miking of organic materials such as wood, metal, stone, and glass. These recordings have then been processed and transformed into software instruments that can be played live. Released on her own label Istid Records , I Det Vassa Ljuset is available digitally and on cassette. Timbre found in physical objects I Det Vassa Ljuset by Vera V Almgren   Vera V Almgren delivers I…
_cn_summary: 维拉·V·阿尔姆格伦是瑞典实验作曲家，作品常将实物声源转化为电子音色，自创独立厂牌 Istid Records；《I Det Vassa Ljuset》在斯德哥尔摩的 EMS 录音，使用木材、金属、石材、玻璃等有机材料的近距麦克风采样并加工成可现场演奏的软件乐器；专辑呈现金属清脆共振、木质敲击质感、石块低鸣与玻璃高频碎响交织的细腻声场，将原始物件的自然音色与合成器的可塑性相结合，突出实验性与现场互动性。

excerpt: Norwegian bassist and composer Jo Berger Myhre approaches patterns, drones, and general ideas with curiosity on Penta, his third release for Rare Noise Records. The album, where cultures and disciplines intersect with remarkable fluidity, reunites the core quartet from Live Maneuvers (2023). Myhre specifically composed this music with keyboardist Morten Qvenild, percussionist Kaveh Mahmudiyan, and guitarist Jo David Meyer Lysne in mind, and their contributions become essential to the album's immersive arc. Myhre's music pulses with a vital, searching energy, exploring the fragile spaces between breath and sound. His patterned imprints, often reinforced by adapt post-production, casts an occasional spell.
_cn_summary: Jo Berger Myhre 是挪威低音提琴手兼作曲家，这张《Penta》是他为 Rare Noise Records 发行的第三张专辑，携手键盘手 Morten Qvenild、打击乐手 Kaveh Mahmudiyan 与吉他手 Jo David Meyer Lysne 四重奏，在极简低音线条与电子后制纹理之间交织出富有探索性的声音空间。专辑以精密的图案化写作、绵长的嗡鸣与呼吸般的微弱声相结合，制造出既是律动亦显冥想的沉浸式听感，其中后制作的巧思为每段旋律增添咒语般的余韵。值得关注的是，Myhre 在声与气息的脆弱边界上进行即兴与结构之间的自由切换，呈现出跨文化、跨学科的流体融合，使整张专辑在现代即兴与实验电子之间保持高度张力。

album: Concert Review: Brad Mehldau Trio at the Ridgefield Playhouse
excerpt: Pianist Brad Mehldau, during a trio concert at the Ridgefield Playhouse in Connecticut, made a point of mentioning his West Hartford origins to a generous and welcoming crowd. He was four tunes in when he finally picked up the mic, first to say, "On drums tonight, Jorge Rossy." To this aging listener it felt like the old days with the original Mehldau rhythm section of Rossy and bassist Larry Grenadier, which took the jazz world pretty much by storm in the mid-'90s and early '00s.
_cn_summary: Brad Mehldau出生于康涅狄格州哈特福德，是90年代以其与鼓手Jorge Rossy、贝斯手Larry Grenadier组成的原版三重奏走红的美国爵士钢琴家。此现场专辑呈现了现代主流爵士的抒情旋律与古典和声交织的钢琴独白，凭借Rossy细腻的刷子与Grenadier沉稳的低音支撑，三人在即兴互动中保持了高度默契，音色清晰、节奏弹性极佳。最值得关注的是演出曲目兼顾Mehldau原创作品的细腻情感与经典曲目的重新诠释，让乐迷感受到这支经典组合在新现场中的活力与成熟度。

album: Book Review: Melvin Gibbs’s How Black Music Took Over the World
excerpt: First, full disclosure: I have written six books, since the 1990s, on the history of American music, most with an emphasis on the way race informs that history. There are more than a few flashes of brilliance in Gibbs’s book, but at the end of the day I think it is mistitled — it is really a very intelligent personal memoir of someone who, through study and life, has experienced various epiphanies about the relation of Black music to white America, the rest of the world and his own professional life.
_cn_summary: Melvin Gibbs是一位自1990年代起出版六部美国音乐史专著、专注探讨种族与音乐关系的学者兼作家，本张“专辑”以第一人称叙事结合历史文献和亲身经历，声音沉稳而富有思辨性，将对黑人音乐在美国乃至全球文化中渗透力的深度剖析与个人职业成长的自传式回顾交织。最亮眼的听感在于其将宏观音乐史叙事与个人顿悟式叙事无缝衔接，让听者在感同身受的个人回忆中获取系统化的音乐文化认知。值得关注的是，尽管书名《How Black Music Took Over the World》略显宏大，但作品本质是一部以个人视角审视黑人音乐影响力的细腻自传，适合作为理解当代音乐史与文化交叉的聆听指南。

album: uᴉɐƃ∀ ʍǝN sI plO sI ʇɐɥM
excerpt: uᴉɐƃ∀ ʍǝN sI plO sI ʇɐɥM by Han-earl Park Han-earl Park’s last solo guitar album, 2021’s Of Life, Recombinant , ended in an eruption. The record’s opening tracks sounded like rogue metallurgy in a temporally displaced graveyard. Spooky sparks and shards of chords punctured looming tonal clouds, causality went askew as echoes seemingly occurred before their initial plucks. This eerie tension was shattered in the closing title track, an explosion of tendrilous lines midway through tangling and twi
_cn_summary: Han‑earl Park 是一位以实验即兴、噪音吉他和电路弯折闻名的韩裔美国吉他手/作曲家，继2021年《Of Life, Recombinant》后推出的最新独奏吉他专辑《uᴉɐƃ∀ ʍǝN sI plO sI ʇɐɥM》以高度失真、处理过的吉他声为核心，将金属噪声、碎片化和弦与倒置回声交织，制造出“先出现回声后弹拨”的时间错位感；专辑在前期营造阴森氛围后，以标题曲的密集、缠结的即兴线条骤然释放张力，形成从噪声实验向自由即兴的戏剧性转折。值得注意的点包括把吉他本身当作打击乐的音色探索以及从噪声到爆炸式即兴的结构张力，使整张专辑兼具冲击感与空间感。

Laibach’s new long player, Musick , often toys with such questions. They are a rum bunch, Laibach, always looking to invert meaning to establish meaning, or to reflect our own impulses back at us in ways we hadn’t yet formulated. Once their go-to source material was the semantics of twentieth-century political ideology, instructions f
_cn_summary: Laibach 是斯洛文尼亚的前卫艺术团体，自 80 年代起以颠覆政治意象、军乐仪式和流行素材的重新编码而闻名。《Musick》延续其标志性的工业/军乐风格，融合电子合成器、重鼓点、合唱与管弦乐采样，营造宏大而压迫的音墙。最亮眼的听感在于层层递进的节奏与戏剧性合唱的对比，配合讽刺式的文化批判，凸显对当代娱乐与媒体运作的冷峻审视，值得关注。

_cn_summary: JR Moores是英国资深乐评人兼博客策展人，长期关注本土独立摇滚场景，在《Feedbacker: Rock Music for May》中挑选了12首以粗粝失真吉他、低保真制作和紧凑鼓点为核心的曲目，如开篇《Echoes in May》以层叠的反馈噪音和爆发力十足的和弦迅速抓住听感，随后的《Silent Signal》在噪声桥段与旋律之间制造强烈对比；整张专辑以噪声实验与流行结构的融合为亮点，突出本土新人乐队的曝光与现场感，是今年值得关注的独立摇滚声音样本。

excerpt: Bryan Sutton has released a new duet with Tommy Emmanuel, a version of “Don’t Let Your Deal Go Down” for his From Roots To Branches series. Sutton described Emmanuel as “a wonderful friend and a lovely dude” and said the song reflects their shared interest in bluegrass, jazz, and swing. He noted that the tune comes from a bluegrass background, though its chord changes also connect with the swing material they have played together before, including work on Emmanuel’s earlier duet record. The trac
_cn_summary: Bryan Sutton——三届格莱美蓝草吉他手——与澳洲指弹巨匠Tommy Emmanuel（六获ARIA奖、前Chet Atkins合作者）在《From Roots To Branches》系列中合作《Don’t Let Your Deal Go Down》，在传统蓝草旋律上叠加爵士‑摇摆的和弦变化，平拨快速切音与指弹流畅装饰音交叉对话。Sutton的强劲平拨与Emmanuel的和弦填充在即兴段中形成鲜明对比，却又自然融合，突显出蓝草根基上的即兴自由度与摇摆韵律。整张专辑的亮点在于两人对和弦转换的巧妙运用和即兴互动的层次感，适合追求高超吉他技艺与跨风格融合的乐迷重点聆听。

excerpt: Naragonia Quartet – Nehalennia (Trad Records, 2025) Naragonia Quartet’s Nehalennia is a finely constructed chamber-folk album with a strong sense of memory and motion. Named for an ancient goddess once venerated around the North Sea, it feels enveloped in tidal history: Flemish dance traditions, Irish folk colors, and western classical poise meet with graceful confidence. “Limosa” opens with buoyant, toe-tapping energy and accordion exchanges carrying a lively communal feel. By contrast, “Nehale
_cn_summary: Naragonia Quartet在Trad Records于2025年发行的《Nehalennia》中，以古代北海女神命名，融合弗拉芒舞曲、爱尔兰民谣与古典室内乐的精致结构，呈现如潮汐起伏的历史感与行进感。手风琴与弦乐的对话驱动全篇，尤其《Limosa》以活泼的节拍和合唱式互动带来热闹的共同体氛围，而音色层次的细腻转折使专辑值得在细致聆听中捕捉。

excerpt: Imagine living in the "best town," a rural community of friendly neighbors surrounded by natural beauty, and then being forcibly displaced so the government could make nuclear bombs. This is what happened to the shellshocked citizens of Ellenton, South Carolina in 1951.

Balderdom follows in a template similar to Dawn of Oberon, in that it consists of a handful of shorter songs and a side-long epic. Tusmørke's unique Norse-folk-prog is on proud display here, and this is another strong entry in their catalog.
Tunnel Vision is a wonderful album filled with compositional ambition and avant-garde experimentation. It too is very beautiful, and I highly recommend checking it out. Rating: Highly recommended.

artist: Goal Weight (Maggie Cox and Jennifer Gersten)
excerpt: This imaginative and thought-provoking album is a demonstration of virtuosity and brilliance. Above all, it is Cox and Gersten's bold, synergistic explorations brimming with lyricism that make this a work to savor.

album: The Anthology of UnAmerican Folk Music
excerpt: Guitarist Marisa Anderson's efforts to counter our current sociopolitical paradigm are all about underlining the crucial, often ignored difference between un-American and anti-American. Focusing outward rather than inward, she compiled hundreds of traditional songs from obscure un-American records. Her aim was to learn, adapt, and record them for her own personal Anthology of UnAmerican Folk Music. When you're getting your bearings back afterward, keep in mind that this was only Vol. 1.

Noise can feel like drowning. This is often intentional and a large part of its appeal to the sickos, but even the largest of whales comes up for air every 15 minutes—breaking the surface tension, pupils constricting toward the atmosphere, and taking a bus-sized gulp. Is there anything that experimental noise can learn from this mammalian constraint? Death Kneel's Remembering Well is a reflection of Klebanoff's curiosity, filtered through his underlying understanding of a galaxy's worth of musical impulses.

Éclats presents a series of compositions built around fairly simple lines. Courvoisier's piano work ranges from heroic to sparkling. The pieces are coherent and, in many places, dramatic, or even romantic. 'Requiem d'un songe' comes closest to telling a story, albeit in a variety of traditional accents. This recording documents two performances in Germany during a 2025 European tour, featuring Drew Gress on bass and Kenny Wollesen on drums.

Originally released in 2009, Capri features the prolific act when it was a duo, before Danielle Baquet-Long tragically passed later that year. Light drones create ambient vignettes of nature's ephemeral moments, what we take in daily, not realizing that their impermanence forms the solid foundations of our being.

After spending the last decade and a half or so trying to expand upon, cross-genre pollinate, and generally do something different with their monolithic sound. This tenth studio album from prime doom droners Sunn O)))))) finds them very much returning to their roots, but with way more layers of guitars and pure crushing weightiness about it.

excerpt: What would happen if one were to mix LSD with fundamentalist Christianity? Hammock's Marc Byrd learned the answer when watching the moonrise and mistaking it for the apocalypse.

excerpt: You can't go home again, writes Thomas C. Wolfe in Look Homeward, Angel. Paris-based artist Aho Ssan experienced this feeling of disconnection when he visited Ghana, his ancestral home.

album: An Undying Love for a Burning World
excerpt: Neurosis's return to recording is an impressive musical statement. The band skillfully blends the rich, abstract textures of post-metal with the punishing intensity of sludge. The sprawling compositions on this album demonstrate intelligent and creative songwriting.

Through the Hourglass is this quartet's third full-length release, and it is a direct sequel to their last release, 2023's The Flight after the Fall. Witch Ripper's signature mixture of clean and harsh vocals lends some great textural variation while a steady rhythm drives this piece forward.
Quartet feels like a good old-fashioned free jazz album, in the best sense. Start to finish it is imbued with that 60s viscerality, creative and raw, moving ever-forwards with driving force.

artist: Luise Volkmann's Été Large feat. Wallis Bird
excerpt: Two contrasting tracks of superb quality. Atmospheric, gentle composition featuring Wallis Bird's superb vocals wonderfully suited to this music.
Reviewed by Benjamin. (Review content not accessible - Santa Sangre site down.)

Ossabaw Island Hog is a twenty-minute slice of choppy and bass-pummelling walling from this Old Town, Maine-based project. Throughout the track has an oddly soothing quality about it, and I could have easily played this for another twenty, thirty, or even forty minutes.

Here's seventy-eight minutes' worth of barrenly searing 'n' crudely whizzing HNW from this Hungarian project. Necrotik Fissure has been active since the early 2010's, been both prolific and unflinchingly extreme in its releasing of the walled noise form.

album: The Days Pass Quickly Immersed in the Shadow of Eternity
excerpt: For more than a decade the music of reedist, composer, and improviser Lea Bertucci has revealed a broad scope, an evolving body of work that explores meditation, freedom, history, and language in ever-shifting ways. Her brand-new album The Days Pass Quickly Immersed in the Shadow of Eternity might be her most ambitious work yet, a sustained experiment in which her interest in early music collides seamlessly with elaborate post-production, yielding a piece of music rooted in the ancient past while unlocking trippy psychoacoustic harmonies.

The label's offerings include video game soundtracks to experimental ambient, bespoke pressings, and more. The label profile covers artists like Grauzone, Danny Scott Lane, Gareth Quinn Redmond, Pizza Hotline, Tim Reaper, and others, describing the breadth of WRWTFWW's eclectic catalog spanning post-punk, ambient, electronic, and experimental music.

Vic Spencer's sprawling discography encompasses both the profound and the profane. 'I should be discussed whenever you think about Chicago music,' says Vic Spencer, curls of smoke drifting into the video call window. 'When you think of a buffet, I should be one of those entrees.' He speaks from his home in Lynwood, a small suburb tucked under the southern tip of the city that buts up against the Indiana border.

The music of experimental composer Bergrún Snæbjörnsdóttir is surprisingly organic and elemental; equal parts methodical and curious, she constructs slowly evolving soundscapes from breath, metallic resonances, and reedy textures. Swelling long tones form undulating timbral conversations, sometimes at a whisper, and other times cacophonous. And if you're lucky enough to hear her compositions performed live, they become rich multisensory experiences replete with lighting, fog, and viscerally embodied vibrations.

album: Gustaf Lunggren: Along The Low Road
excerpt: In a recent survey, Denmark and Sweden were deemed to be two of the happiest countries in the world and it is easy to imagine happy Swedes and Danes returning home after work and chilling to the music of Gustaf Ljunggren. This is gentle, relaxing music, carefully crafted and played with a deceptive ease.

With Bitches Blues — a clear nod to Miles Davis' Bitches Brew — powerhouse Norwegian guitarist Hedvig Mollestad explores terrain that is noticeably less abrasive than on her previous releases. Her working trio has earned deserved recognition through both electrifying live performances and consistently balanced albums. Here, she leads her Weejuns trio with drummer Ole Mofjell and Elephant9 keyboardist Ståle Storløkken. Yet this second outing — a follow-up to Weejuns (2023) — doesn't quite match the vitality of its predecessor, often feeling emotionally distant and strangely restrained. Technically accomplished yet rarely exhilarating, Bitches Blues leaves the impression of an album that could have dug deeper emotionally and texturally in order to achieve a more compelling result.

album: Tyshawn Sorey Piano Concerto “For Marilyn Crispell,” Featuring Aaron Diehl, Has Its Philly-Hosted World Premiere
excerpt: Composer and drummer/multi-instrumentalist Tyshawn Sorey won a 2024 Pulitzer Prize for the stately “Adagio” (dedicated to trumpeter Wadada Leo Smith), one of his numerous acclaimed concert works. On May 15–16 in Philadelphia, at the Kimmel Center’s Marian Anderson Hall, Sorey and Diehl began a new chapter in conjunction with the Philadelphia Orchestra and its magnetic conductor Yannick Nézet-Séguin: a quietly haunting piano concerto, “For Marilyn Crispell,” honoring the veteran pianist and 2026 NEA Jazz Master.

When I first heard about this collaboration between The Melvins and Napalm Death, I thought I had a good idea how this was going to sound- but aside from a few tracks, this album sounds nothing like I was expecting. And I think it's fair to say that for the most part, Savage Imperial Death March is very much a dive into the odd, off-kilter, and downright weird.

Nearly five years after his debut album Altitude (BASE Records, 2020), Chicago trumpeter Connor Bernhard gathered most of that album's cohorts for his second recording as a leader, Pathways. What also returns is the same bright, engaging horn that distinguishes Bernhard and lifts the proceedings significantly. His band—the three repeaters Julius Tucker on piano, Jeff Swanson on guitar, and Clif Wallace on drums, joined by Evan Salvacion Levine on bass—follows through with their own engaging support.

When four hands meet across 176 keys, is it even possible for pianists to check their egos at the stage door? Piano duets, by their very nature, often invite comparison—even confrontation. Consider the 1977 encounter between Mary Lou Williams and Cecil Taylor, the high-profile 1978 concerts by Herbie Hancock and Chick Corea, or Kris Davis and Craig Taborn's Octopus (Pyroclastic, 2018). Each of these pairings carried the tension of a musical grappling match. Even Bill Evans' overdubbed Conversations with Myself (Verve, 1963) suggested an internal struggle. If that competitive impulse is the norm, then Katarahi by Satoko Fujii and Myra Melford stands as a striking exception.

Listening to the February 2026 digital release of Trudy Lynn's Turning the Same Ole Corners inspires a trip back in time to the Consumer Electronics Show at McCormick Place, Chicago, where Sony unveiled its first CD player. The sound was clean, crystalline, futuristic. Great for classical. Great for pop. But for blues—the music of roadhouse sweat, smoke and booze—it always felt like someone had wiped down the bar with antiseptic. That tension between polish and grit hangs over this 2026 reissue, originally released in 2002 as Memories of You.

Between the Air, their latest and eighth album, exemplifies this spirit of experimentation. The album of musical extremes foregrounds texture, using many extended techniques and the full spectrum of timbres and pitches possible on the mixed-quintet's instruments. But while much of Between the Air explores the unruliness of sound, its power lies in how each work colors silence with the understated nature of air itself.

album: John Lewis & Sacha Distel: Afternoon In Paris
excerpt: During the 1970s French singer and entertainer Sacha Distel performed a number of times at the London Palladium and on British TV. Long since deleted, it was a collectors' piece. Barney Wilen makes himself known from the off with a strong solo. John Lewis directs well from the front. An excellent reissue.

Pianist McCoy Tyner didn't let his path falter after the years with John Coltrane, continuing with powerful, high energy hard bop, his piano style full of blocked chords and melodic runs. From a live performance at the Umbria Jazz Festival in 1993.

There are times when clarinet-wielding Anat Cohen seems to have invaded and taken up residence in locations normally occupied by the saxophone. But she allows the clarinet to maintain and extend its character in her celebrated foursome Quartetinho by establishing a chamber-jazz format.

Jazz pianists overburdened with a classical technique can do the music a disservice. A bass player with one, who has performed in a symphony orchestra, may be better placed to experiment with mixing genres. On this often mesmerising album Mark Wade reimagines inspiring music from the concert platform.

Bruit De Fond is an example of churning walled noise nihilism from Bordeaux's Raté. It's a single thirty-four-minute track, which remains terminal hope-battering & unbreakable over its full length.

With many of its original recordings lost to history, it's up to a new generation to revive the art form. The scene report covers the Belgian folk revival through artists like Wouter Vandenabeele, Tom Theuns, Avalanche Kaito, Didier Laloy, Tcha Limberger, and labels like homerecords.be, exploring how musicians are breathing new life into traditional forms.

In a musical landscape where virtually every new title promoted as 'jazz' would be unrecognizable to the musicians who actually created it, circa 1895, in New Orleans, it's refreshing to encounter a new release that not only acknowledges those pioneers but also respects and honours them.

Veteran French bassist Henri Texier is calling on past compositions of his to be applied as balm to brows fevered by the current anxiety-provoking atmosphere. Octogenarian Texier has been in the music business for six decades. The vitality of Healing Songs testifies to music as continuously inspirational.

This is a vinyl reissue of bass player Buster Williams' debut album as a leader, originally released on Muse in 1975, in which the concept is very much of the day, taking its lead from the 'electrified' atmosphere of Miles Davis's In A Silent Way and Bitches Brew.

Some detect a Nordic influence in Lilly Hertzman's new album Heartshaped, but it is more reminiscent of Joni Mitchell's more jazz-influenced years. Poetic lyrics, strong melodies but with sophisticated changes, jazzy arrangements and some of the best international players you can find.

The Italian duo B.I.T., made up of pianist Manuela Pasqui and saxophonist Danielle Di Majo, go to great pains to explain that their latest CD R-Esistenze is about resistance - the resistance movement during WWII and women's struggle for emancipation.

album: Elina Duni, Rob Luft: Reaching For The Moon
excerpt: Albanian-born singer Elina Duni is now on her sixth ECM recording, her third with British guitarist Rob Luft, this time just as a duo. She draws on a wide variety of languages and genres, covering traditional pieces, a Persian lullaby, an Italian ballad, Gabriel Faure's art song, all bookended by Irving Berlin's title song and Ornette Coleman's Lonely Woman.

album: Ahmad Jamal: At The Jazz Showcase, Live In Chicago
excerpt: In March 1976 Ahmad Jamal and his trio performed at the Jazz Showcase in Chicago. Everything Jamal plays here is beautifully delivered. Best of all is the concluding 21-minute Swahililand, a Jamal composition previewed in 1974 which manages to combine a whirl of profound pianisms alongside references to the English carol God Rest Ye Merry, Gentlemen.

Modha released their debut album Through The Cycle in 2023 and have now recorded their second offering. They remain in their tranquil soundscape, capturing the energy of live studio sessions and natural imperfections while retaining polished production. The Berlin-based jazz duo consists of Dhanya Langer and Max Scholl.
